groups.title: Seen at the last token
groups.definition: Answered correctly; the J-lens has the bridge ranked first among the entities in >= 50% of layers 32-48 at the last token.

groups.title: Seen only earlier in the prompt
groups.definition: Answered correctly; missed at the last token (< 50%) but on top at some earlier token (>= 50%).

groups.title: Not seen anywhere
groups.definition: Answered correctly; the J-lens never has the bridge ranked first among the entities in >= 50% of layers 32-48 at any token.

groups.title: Distractor above the bridge
groups.definition: Answered correctly; at the last token the same-category distractor is ranked first among the entities in more band layers than the bridge.

groups.title: J-lens and J++ disagree
groups.definition: Answered correctly; at the last token the two lenses' band shares for the bridge differ by >= 0.5.

groups.title: Model answers wrong
groups.definition: The model does not give the answer. Does the lens still see the bridge?
